sql: select created_at, (raw_json->>'skipped_contest_cap') as skip_contest, (raw_json->>'skipped_event_rung_cap') as skip_rung, (raw_json->>'opened') as opened, (raw_json->'per_book'->>'Gmmsell0') as g0, (raw_json->'per_book'->>'Gmmsell1') as g1 from system_events where component='mmsell_scan' and created_at > now() - interval '110 minutes' order by created_at desc limit 12
